title: I need help with the gameplay
author: Gullible-Agent-4779
selftext:
I made this roguelike minesweeper game with Claud. The audio is from free audio libraries. 

The goal was to try to make Minesweeper more interesting, but I'm not sure if this is the right path. The mines in this version are "dungeons" that I plan on upgrading soon, but I'm not sure if it's worth it. The more mines you hit, the harder the game becomes. I also developed a whole storyline for the game.

Would you be interested in a more interesting Minesweeper game? I may pivot from this version of the idea to a more arcade-like Minesweeper game. 

You can play it here: [https://monster-minesweeper.vercel.app](https://monster-minesweeper.vercel.app) 

All thoughts and feedback are welcome.
